definitions.explanation: A climbing vine whose large white flowers open in the evening. Its fruit is used to make {干瓢|かんぴょう} (dried gourd strips, often eaten in sushi).

examples.japanese: {夕顔|ゆうがお}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{咲|さ}いた→咲く：08150_saku⟧。
{夕顔|ゆうがお}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{夕方|ゆうがた}→夕方：01010_yuugata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{白|しろ}い→白い：00587_shiroi⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{咲|さ}かせる→咲く：08150_saku⟧。
examples.english: The moonflower opens white blossoms in the evening.

examples.japanese: {夕顔|ゆうがお}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{実|み}→実：03741_mi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{細長|ほそなが}く→細長い：06670_hosonagai⟧⟦{削|けず}って→削る：03922_kezuru⟧⟦{干|ほ}した→干す：00115_hosu⟧もの⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{干瓢|かんぴょう}→干瓢：10790_kanpyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Kanpyo is the strips of moonflower fruit shaved thin and dried.

notes:
Named from {夕|ゆう} (evening) + {顔|がお} (face), reflecting that the flowers open at dusk. Belongs to the gourd family, not the morning-glory family despite the parallel naming.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {夕顔|ゆうがお}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{咲|さ}く→咲く：08150_saku⟧: moonflowers bloom
- {夕顔|ゆうがお}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{実|み}→実：03741_mi⟧: the fruit of the moonflower
- {夕顔|ゆうがお}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{棚|たな}→棚：01650_tana⟧: a moonflower trellis

CULTURAL NOTE:
{夕顔|ゆうがお} is also the name of a famous chapter and character in The Tale of Genji ({源氏物語|げんじものがたり}), giving the word strong literary associations.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{朝顔|あさがお}→朝顔：05001_asagao⟧: morning glory — opens in the morning; the parallel-naming partner
- ⟦{昼顔|ひるがお}→昼顔：28688_hirugao⟧: bindweed — opens during the day
- {夜顔|よるがお}: moonflower (Ipomoea alba) — different plant, also opens at night
